content.title: NiSource Stock Is Headed for Largest Percent Decrease In Five Months. Here’s Why.
content.summary: Shares of regulated utility company  NiSource  were headed for their steepest decline in five months on Thursday as questions swirled regarding the spinoff of a subsidiary focused on data centers.  Merrillville, Ind.-based  NiSource  provides natural gas and electricity through its Columbia Gas and Northern Indiana Public Service Company (NIPSCO) brands.  The Indiana Utility Regulatory Commission (IURC) is overseeing a proposal to create a lightly regulated subsidiary of NIPSCO called GenCo, which would fund capacity for data-center customers.
